broad_validation.adapter_source:
import json, os, re, subprocess, time
from pathlib import Path
root=Path('/workspace/wwo-sandbox')
out=root/'builds/sandbox-broad';out.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
env=os.environ.copy()
for key,sub in [('XDG_DATA_HOME','data'),('XDG_CONFIG_HOME','config'),('XDG_CACHE_HOME','cache')]:
 p=out/'.xdg'/sub;p.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);env[key]=str(p)
steps=json.loads((root/'experiments/war_resolver/evidence/results.json').read_text())['unified_validation']['steps']
fatal=re.compile(r'(?im)^ERROR:(?!\s+\d+\s+resources still in use at exit\b)|SCRIPT ERROR|Parse Error|Failed to load script|Assertion failed|[1-9][0-9]* failures')
results=[]
for i,step in enumerate(steps):
 started=time.monotonic();command=step['command']
 try:
  p=subprocess.run(command,cwd=root,env=env,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=600);log=p.stdout+p.stderr;code=p.returncode
 except subprocess.TimeoutExpired: log='TIMEOUT';code=-1
 (out/f'{i:02d}.log').write_text(log)
 results.append(dict(name=step['name'],command=command,returncode=code,passed=code==0 and not fatal.search(log),wall_seconds=round(time.monotonic()-started,3),summaries=[s for s in log.splitlines() if re.search(r'checks|SHA256|Ran \d+ tests|^FAILED|^OK$',s)]))
 (out/'results.json').write_text(json.dumps(results,indent=2))
 print(f"{i+1}/49 {'PASS' if results[-1]['passed'] else 'FAIL'} {step['name']}",flush=True)
print('RESULT',sum(s['passed'] for s in results),'passed',len(results),'total')
